role: The mob spawner block entity: wraps a MobSpawnerBaseLogic bound to its own position, delegating NBT, the tick and the client event.

members.name: $1.func_98267_a
members.note: addBlockEvent(52, 1): the server's own event pass calls setDelayToMin, which acts only on a client world; the playable client resets its spinner from the server delay (play.c:tileents_tick).

members.name: updateEntity
members.note: The server half (tileticks.c:spawner_update, te-spawner-s1) and the client spin (raster_tileents_spawner_tick). The client half's three WorldClient.rand floats and its smoke and flame (nothing is constructed under the pinned minimal particles) move only the client world's Random, which the whole-server replay and the playable client do not keep (test_clientworld does, over walks without a spawner): a follow-up for the client-world lane.

members.name: getDescriptionPacket
members.note: The playable client draws each tile entity from the server's copy (one process: play.c, raster_tileent.c), so the description packet's content, sent whenever the server copy changes, is what it already reads; no row carries the client copy.

members.name: receiveClientEvent
members.note: The server call is setDelayToMin, a no-op off a client world; the client spinner reset is play.c:tileents_tick.

notes: lane/idxblocks: reviewed. lane/reloadstate: tiles-reload-s1 unloads a spawner mid-delay and reloads it (coverage, passed on master).
